attestations.note: The last of the six the one listing line names, with his own head line on the shared page. The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. This folder closes a refusal the first reader of this day made: he drafted only Zenon, Mark and Macarius, and refused Neophytos, Gaius and Gaianos because the corpus already keeps `neophytus-5-may`, `gaius-5-may` and `gaianus-5-may` with `greek` rows venerated on 5 Μαΐου, saint.gr's «Άγιοι Νεόφυτος, Γάιος και Γαϊανός οι Μάρτυρες». That refusal was against the corpus's settled rule: two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, and so two men. The 5 May three are therefore other men, their rows are not touched, and this folder is surnamed with its own day so that it cannot be read as the 5 May man. saint.gr gives no year, no country and no relics, so there is no `dates` object. The page prints two distichs and no hymn, and this Gaianos belongs to the second of them. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
